# Ubuntu Desktop Simulator

> An Ubuntu desktop simulator built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS by Dawid Olko. It runs in the browser with a dock, draggable windows, a terminal, settings and a set of working demo applications.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ubuntu.dawidolko.pl/): the simulated desktop

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
